data.name: Sharikat
data.long_meaning: A woman who is involved in trade or business, or a partnership in any form.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the unity and harmony in relationships and partnerships, as well as the potential for financial success and prosperity.
data.numerology_meaning: A nurturer and healer, with a strong desire to help and care for others.

in_arabic.name: شركات
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني الشركة أو الجمعية أو الاتحاد
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم 'شركات' مشتق من كلمة 'شركة' التي تعني في اللغة العربية الشركة أو الجمعية أو الاتحاد. وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في سورة الأنفال آية 72 'وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَاتَّبَعَتْهُمُ ذُرِّيَّاتُهُم بِإِيمَانٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمُ ذُرِّيَّاتِهِمُ وَمَا أَضَرَّنَا بِهِمُ أَحَدًا وَأَوْلَئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجِنَانِ هُمُ فِيهَا مُخَلَدُونَ'. يدل هذا الاسم على معنى الائتلاف والاجتماع في الخير والصلاح.

in_urdu.name: شرکات
in_urdu.meaning: کمپنی یا فلم یا ایسوسی ایشن
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسم 'شرکات' عربی زبان کی اصطلاح 'شركة' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے کمپنی، فلم یا ایسوسی ایشن. یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں شرکت اور اجتماع کی علامت ہے. جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان، یہ نام روایتی اور مذہبی اہمیت کا حامل ہے.

in_hindi.name: शरikat
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम 'शरikat' का उद्गम 'شركة' से हुआ है, जिसका अर्थ है कंपनी, संगठन या संघ. इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम सहयोग और एकता का प्रतीक है. भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम पारंपरिक और धार्मिक महत्व रखता है.

in_pashto.name: شرکت
in_pashto.long_meaning: د 'شرکت' نوم 'شركة' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د شرکت یا ټولنې. په افغان او پښتون دود کې، دا نوم د یوالي او همکارۍ نښه ده. دا نوم په مذهبي او کلتوري لحاظ مهم دی.

in_english.name: Sharikat
in_english.long_meaning: The name 'Sharikat' originates from the Arabic root 'ش-ر-ك' (sharaka), which means to share or participate. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes unity, cooperation, and partnership. It is derived from the word 'sharikat,' meaning companies, associations, or unions. Historically, this name has been used across various Muslim cultures to signify collective efforts and shared goals. The name is associated with positive personality traits such as teamwork, diplomacy, and social responsibility.

data.cultural_impact: The term "Sharika" or "Sharikat" in Arabic language translates to 'partnership' or 'joint-stock company' in English. It signifies the economic empowerment of women and their association with business and entrepreneurship, often through the formation of cooperatives or partnerships. In several Islamic countries, women entrepreneurs often utilize the legal structure of "Sharikat" to protect their interests and establish their businesses. The promotion and establishment of such enterprises contribute significantly to the economic development of the Muslim world whilst challenging gender stereotypes and demonstrating the potential of women to succeed in various spheres.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of "Sharikat" lies in the principles of cooperation, collaboration, and unity that underpin this term. Moreover, it symbolizes the economic prosperity that stems from collective efforts and the interconnectivity of the community. In the context of Islamic teachings, the concept of "Ribat," or the protection and investment in one's property, is essential for both economic and spiritual growth. A "Sharikat" that adheres to the Islamic principles of doing business ethically and engaging in fair trade not only benefits its members financially, but also fosters a sense of compassion and mutual responsibility among its members and the larger community.
